process.commandLine: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Write-Host 'Test 1: Requesting http://api.github.com via WinHTTP COM (WinHttp.WinHttpRequest.5.1)...'; try { $w = New-Object -ComObject WinHttp.WinHttpRequest.5.1; $w.SetTimeouts(10000,10000,10000,10000); $w.Open('GET','http://api.github.com',$false); $w.Send(); Write-Host ('  Status: ' + $w.Status) } catch { Write-Host ('  Error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Done.'"
